name: YouTube Music Download Helper
author: y-exe
description: Matches a track's title, artist and length against YouTube Music's official catalog — searching in the song's own script — and saves its original AAC/M4A audio.
changelog:
1.0.7: Matching improvements by @Physicsmaniac — store-side title suffixes (- Remastered, - Single Version, (with …), [From …]) are ignored on both sides, 2-character CJK titles survive transliteration suffixes, and when the search rankings hide an official song the extension reads the official album's own track list (title, length and album name; artist aliases tolerated when the names share a 4+-letter word or are written in another script — another artist's cover is still refused). Status fix for the HTTP 302 report (issue #2): a redirect means the host answered, so the source stays active.
1.0.6: Works with Orpheon, the app formerly known as Myspoti — the extension now installs on the new Orpheon app (1.0.0-beta.1 and newer) and on Myspoti 2.x. The extension API itself is unchanged, so nothing changes for existing setups.
